title: My Best Friend
description: Practise simple present sentences and write a short description of a friend.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: My friend Anna ___ twelve years old.
exercises.explanation: Use "is" with he, she, it and one person's name: Anna is twelve.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it, add -s to the verb: she likes.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + adjectives + noun: She has long brown hair. Size (long) comes before colour (brown).

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: With he, the verb needs -s: he plays.

exercises.prompt: Choose the best word to join the ideas.
exercises.explanation: "And" joins two similar, positive ideas: funny and kind.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word: his, her or their.
exercises.text: Ben lives with ___ parents in a small house.
exercises.explanation: Ben is a boy, so we use "his": his parents.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: My best friend ___ got blue eyes.
exercises.explanation: Use "has got" with he, she and it: my best friend has got.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: Add 's to a person to show that something belongs to them: my friend's name.

exercises.prompt: Complete with can or can't.
exercises.text: Anna is very clever. She ___ speak three languages!
exercises.explanation: Use "can" + verb for an ability: she can speak.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Like + verb-ing, and add -s for he/she: she likes reading.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "in" with months: in June.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We is in the same class.
answers: We are in the same class.
exercises.explanation: Use "are" with we, you and they: we are.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: He is small, ___ he is very strong.
exercises.explanation: Use "but" to join two different or opposite ideas.

exercises.prompt: Complete the question with Do or Does.
exercises.explanation: Use "Does" in questions with he, she and it: Does your friend live ...?

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: He sits next to me in class.
In class he sits next to me.
exercises.explanation: Use "next to" for a place beside someone: He sits next to me.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: She has got a orange bike.
answers: She has got an orange bike.
exercises.explanation: Use "an" before a vowel sound: an orange bike.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Tom and Jack are brothers. ___ dog is called Rex.
exercises.explanation: Use "their" before a noun to show that something belongs to them: their dog.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: She has got two little brother.
answers: She has got two little brothers.
exercises.explanation: After a number bigger than one, add -s to the noun: two brothers.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My best friend is very funny.
Is my best friend very funny?
exercises.explanation: Subject + is + very + adjective: My best friend is very funny.

exercises.prompt: Complete with the negative form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.explanation: With he, she and it, make the negative with doesn't (does not) + verb: Sam doesn't like.

contentPoints: Say your friend's name and age.
Describe what your friend looks like.
Say what your friend likes doing.
Say why you like your friend.
task.modelAnswer: My best friend is Lucy. She is eleven years old. She has short black hair and big brown eyes. Lucy likes reading and riding her bike. We play in the park after school. I like her because she is funny and kind.
